design: Evaluator holds all case text until candidate freeze. For each of three consecutive interventions, compare the immediate pre-change and proposed post-change snapshot on the associated two cases. Sample the first case twice per arm, second once; A1.1/A1.2 etc are independent executions, not independent cases. Compare retained final source to initial revision 8 in three separate generalization/regression cases, once per arm. Each turn replays verbatim only prior dialogue from that arm, then supplies only the current learner message. No future messages, grade criteria or snapshot labels in tutor inputs. No outcome-dependent extra samples.
inputs: Use entry skill and exactly four routed documents in every arm: references/deliberate-practice.md, references/tutoring.md, references/study-habits.md and references/provenance.md. Current cases exercise only these routes. Normalize to LF and strip standalone revision markers. Use ephemeral Codex CLI with ignored user config, neutral empty directory, read-only sandbox, no executed tools and no model override. If a candidate adds another instructional dependency, disclose the omission or rerun both as a clearly labeled additional comparison. Real skill discovery tested separately.
freeze: Freeze scenarios, rules, replication plan, grading thresholds and primary/secondary roles before tutor source edits. Guard with SHA-256. No new holdouts after unblinding. Sources read from r8 plus per-stage changed-text overlays offered by the implementer. Same-source follow-up comparisons are labeled negative controls if used. Policies arise from the user request and domain results in the case criteria.
masking: Generate an independent cryptographically random X/Y permutation per pair after generation. Both fresh-context judges receive only the same packet of cases, criteria and labeled transcripts, never the key, implementation or other grades. All complete pairs double-scored before decoding. Do not adjudicate away disagreement. Rating P=all elements satisfied, M=usable core but material omission, F=wrong central answer, material explicit violation, absent core or fabricated evidence. Numerical and mathematical anchors in each criterion are binding.
decision: Per trial per judge, compare the sum of the criterion scores (P=2, M=1, F=0). For a cycle-level measured gain, BOTH judges must have more improving than declining trials, at least one MORE full pass than control, no criterion falling from P/M to F, and no demonstrated severe error in the candidate key or violation of a stop. Otherwise mark tie, mixed or inconclusive and identify tradeoffs. The second sample of case 1 measures stability only; at least one distinct case must show positive direction to both judges. A gain here supports only this sample. Reject unsupported behavioral additions by default; justified interface/clarity changes may be retained on other explicit grounds, without a teaching-quality claim. Final regression passes if no new fails and both judges show no net loss of full passes. Report other cases and regressions individually and keep minority grades.
cost: Report completed/failed cells, counts of calls and observed elapsed durations and token usage including graders. CLI defaults do not expose seed, backend build, model or billed cost reliably. Synthetic roles do not measure learning. Review on actual learner performance and delayed transfer is required for claims about learning.
